name: Carta de Naturalización -- Originario de País Latinoamericano o de la Península Ibérica

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being a national/original of a Latin American country, Spain, or Portugal.

Requires 2 years of continuous legal residence immediately preceding the application, evidenced by temporary or permanent resident cards. Time held as a temporary STUDENT resident does not count toward this period.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 2 continuous years of qualifying (non-student) legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires passing exams on Spanish language and Mexican history/culture. Refugees, minors, and applicants over 60 need only pass the Spanish-language exam.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare for and pass the required exam(s).

requirements.blocker_text: Requires clean federal and local criminal background checks.

evidence_required.document: Temporary or permanent resident card (6+ months validity remaining, non-student)
Federal and local criminal background clearances
Spanish language (and, unless exempt, history-culture) exam

sources.title: Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE) -- Carta de naturalización por ser originario de un país latinoamericano o de la península ibérica: 2-year privileged track

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Mexico's initial build. This is Mexico's 'naturalización privilegiada' rooted in Article 20 of the Ley de Nacionalidad -- a genuinely distinct, nationality-of-origin-based reduced track (2 years vs. the ordinary 5), confirmed directly at tier-1. Not modelled under 'ancestry' category since it does not require Mexican ancestry, only origin from a qualifying country/region -- 'settled' fits better as a naturalisation-track category. Kept as its own file per the same reasoning as mx_naturalisation_residence and mx_naturalisation_marriage.
